_note: 3D Meatball explainer YouTube Short (silverfish), same format as the roach / bed-bug 3D Shorts. The bed-bug bedroom at night: the person sits up in bed with an open book on the blanket; a silverfish is on the page. Beats: silverfish on the book (hook) -> 'Lights on!' the overhead light snaps on and it darts into the book's gutter (it peeks out of the binding on 'Night shift') -> Meatball on the nightstand: night shift -> glue / paper / cereal pop on the blanket and it visits each -> 'MONTHS' calendar -> 'older than dinosaurs' (a toy dinosaur pops up behind it) / 'Like your grandpa' (Meatball sips) -> 'Read it a bedtime story.' cranes back to the opening book for the loop. Voices: PERSON en-US-BrianNeural +6%; MEATBALL en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural +10% +3Hz. No skin/medical framing.
title: Your Book Has a Night Visitor 📚 (Things Living In Your House #50)
pinned_comment: What's the oldest book in your house, and where do you keep it? 👇

source_quotes.ucipm: Silverfish and firebrats come out at night to seek food and water, preferring dry food such as cereals, flour, pasta, pet food, paper with glue or paste, and book bindings. / However, they can live for several months without nourishment. / Unlike other insects, firebrats and silverfish molt continuously throughout their life, passing through 45 to 60 instars ... silverfish about 3 years.
source_quotes.caes: Both hide in cracks and crevices during daylight hours and are active at night. / Silverfish come from an ancient lineage of insects ... Silverfish and firebrats are scavengers that primarily feed on starch. In homes this includes glue, paste, paper, linens, and many stored products.
source_quotes.umd: let's journey back hundreds of millions of years long before T. rex walked the earth to the ancient origins of insects ... primordial relatives of silverfish ... a creature older than dinosaurs.
